name: Peruelé Kalette
source:
Growing up as a sly fox to make ends meet during her hardscrabble days, Peruelé pulled the wool over Sheila's eyes, causing her to fall into captivity to further her selfish schemes.

Despite having the short end of the stick, the princess seems to harbor no ill will. However, Peruelé is constantly walking on eggshells, unable to shake the nagging feeling that the other shoe might drop and Sheila could exact her revenge, even though it never comes to pass.

[Translated and edited from the official site]
